in_sanskrit.name: Yuvaan
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who is full of energy and vitality, a young man in the prime of his life

in_marathi.name: Yuvaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yuvaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'yuva', meaning 'youth'. This name is often used for newborn baby boys. It evokes a sense of vibrancy, energy, and freshness, reflecting the spirit of the young one.
